digest.component_or_area: plan clarity gate and plan-review P1 readiness
propositions: Empty parsed Acceptance Criteria checklist items must fail standalone clarity and block plan-review P1 readiness.
Unresolved sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active execution sections must fail standalone clarity and block plan-review P1 readiness when they appear as assigned values.
Sentinel matches must be suppressed when the same line contains a negation or removal term (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without).
Fenced code blocks and inline backtick code must be excluded from sentinel detection to prevent false positives.
The shared plan-structure helper must recognize only standard checkbox syntax (- [ ] and - [x]) and join continuation lines within Acceptance Criteria sections to determine item body content.
Plan-review P1 and standalone clarity must enforce the same deterministic floor without changing ticket-type exemptions or legacy compatibility scoring.
